statusDetail: Coverage-complete audit of public entry, registration state, directory, legal, auth challenge and 404 archetypes. Account creation and authenticated areas were not covered to avoid creating an account.

page.framework: Server-rendered legacy MPA with JavaScript registration steps
page.notes: Public dating service. /auth presented a Cloudflare verification wall; this was judged as observed flow evidence rather than an audit-wide blocker.

checkOutcomes.evidence: Dark and light screenshots are pixel-identical; computed color-scheme is normal and CSS has no dark preference rule.
The entry page reports no active animations, and its CSS contains no animation that needs reducing.
Forced-colors capture preserves all text, button boundaries, links and app-store controls with system colors.

checkOutcomes.method: Registration DOM interaction and CSS feature probe
checkOutcomes.evidence: The multi-step registration swaps hidden step containers through JavaScript and CSS contains no view-transition usage, producing abrupt state changes.
No parallax, reveal, carousel, or other scroll-linked motion exists on the representative pages.
checkOutcomes.reason: No parallax, reveal, carousel, or other scroll-linked motion exists on the representative pages.

checkOutcomes.evidence: The audited public surfaces contain no gesture-driven carousel, swipe, pull-to-refresh, or custom pointer interaction.
checkOutcomes.reason: The audited public surfaces contain no gesture-driven carousel, swipe, pull-to-refresh, or custom pointer interaction.

checkOutcomes.method: Long-page screenshot and CSS feature probe
checkOutcomes.evidence: The long city listing has static icon chrome and no scroll-state query, progress indicator, or scroll-position feedback.
No tooltip, popover, menu, or other anchored overlay appears on the audited unauthenticated surfaces.
checkOutcomes.reason: No tooltip, popover, menu, or other anchored overlay appears on the audited unauthenticated surfaces.

checkOutcomes.evidence: The listing highlights the active search tab and uses a clear orange page heading and country heading to orient the user.
The entry page loads directly into registration content without an obscuring ad, modal, or consent wall.
No transient overlay or disclosure control is present on the audited public pages.
checkOutcomes.reason: No transient overlay or disclosure control is present on the audited public pages.

checkOutcomes.evidence: The entry page is sparse and content-first, while the listing uses one compact four-item navigation bar.
At 390x844 the layout reports scrollWidth 390, clientWidth 390, zero horizontal overflow, and a scalable viewport meta tag.

checkOutcomes.method: CSS feature probe and DOM styles
checkOutcomes.evidence: The stylesheet has no container queries; reused registration and navigation components rely on fixed widths and viewport rules.

checkOutcomes.method: Focus walk and target rectangle probe
checkOutcomes.evidence: Programmatically focused visible links and registration controls all compute outline-style none; social controls are only 32x32 CSS pixels.
The first viewport clearly states registration and offers two prominent gender choices plus an existing-account route.
The existing-account route is replaced by an indefinite Cloudflare security verification screen in this browser, preventing the login journey.
The invalid registration probe leaves empty .reg-error elements hidden with no role or aria-live announcement; focus remains on body.
Lighthouse reports LCP 1.9s, CLS 0 and TBT 10ms; trace reports LCP 1593ms and no long tasks.
Layout observer and Lighthouse both report CLS 0; the logo image has explicit dimensions.
The trace contains zero long tasks and 0ms total blocking time; Lighthouse TBT is 10ms.

checkOutcomes.method: HAR summary confirmed against script attributes in DOM
checkOutcomes.evidence: The HAR records 356.7KB across 26 requests, with analytics scripts taking about 1.8s and the first-party common script parser-inserted at High priority.
Third-party analytics account for 314KB of 357KB transferred, including both Google and Yandex stacks for a minimal registration screen.

checkOutcomes.method: Rendered registration DOM and invalid submission probe
checkOutcomes.evidence: Registration name and date/location controls are introduced by nearby headings but have no associated label; error containers have no live-region semantics.
axe and Lighthouse identify 8 serious contrast failures; white on #4d8ec5 is 3.5:1 where 4.5:1 is required.
The focus walk found outline none on every tested visible control, so keyboard location is not perceivable.
Body copy and headings remain unclipped at 390px; agreement text has readable line length and spacing.

checkOutcomes.method: Viewport metadata and target rectangle probe
checkOutcomes.evidence: The viewport allows 5x zoom and reflows, but five social-login links are only 32x32 CSS pixels, below the 44x44 target.
Lighthouse errors-in-console audit passes with no items.

checkOutcomes.method: Platform probe, Lighthouse and image audit
checkOutcomes.evidence: The document has an HTML doctype and declared charset; Lighthouse passes doctype, charset and aspect ratio, and the image audit finds explicit dimensions.
Lighthouse passes deprecations and BFCache; no permission prompt appeared on load.
The page exposes a descriptive Russian title and meta description.

checkOutcomes.method: DOM link inventory and platform probe
checkOutcomes.evidence: Primary registration choices are JavaScript-only href="#" links, and several image links have no visible link text despite the viewport and robots file being valid.
The page returned 200, declares the correct canonical, robots permits the entry page and points to successful sitemaps, with no observed noindex.
Open Graph metadata is present, but there is no JSON-LD or other structured entity data for the public dating service.
HTTPS is used, but CSP, HSTS and nosniff are absent; SESSIONID is neither Secure nor HttpOnly and all seven cookies use SameSite=None.
The minimal entry screen contacts seven third-party origins and loads Google/DoubleClick plus Yandex analytics before consent.

checkOutcomes.method: DOM auth inventory and auth journey
checkOutcomes.evidence: No permission prompt fires on load, but inspected sign-in choices expose federated providers only and no passkey/WebAuthn capability; existing-account auth is bot-gated.
X-Frame-Options is present, but HSTS, Referrer-Policy, Permissions-Policy and CSP/frame-ancestors are missing.
The crawler screenshot with JavaScript disabled is blank even though the rendered page contains the entire registration entry experience.

checkOutcomes.method: Journey screenshots and Lighthouse console audit
checkOutcomes.evidence: The registration step swap, long listing and 404 state rendered without clipped overlays or uncaught errors in the exercised states.
A manifest link exists but navigator.serviceWorker.getRegistrations() returns none, so this app-promoting service has no offline fallback.
A nonexistent route renders a useful, content-rich not-found state with navigation and alternative profiles rather than a blank shell.
html lang is ru, but CSS has no logical-property signal and extensively uses physical left/right positioning despite a global country selector.
The product offers many countries but the interface remains Russian and the registration DOM shows hand-authored month/country strings with no evidence of locale-aware Intl formatting.
No event time, appointment, calendar, or time-zone-sensitive value appears in the audited public registration, listing, legal, or error surfaces.
checkOutcomes.reason: No event time, appointment, calendar, or time-zone-sensitive value appears in the audited public registration, listing, legal, or error surfaces.

checkOutcomes.evidence: The title and meta promise dating “without registration,” while the first viewport is explicitly a registration gate and the main choices begin account creation.
Invalid registration submission does not expose a visible error, move focus to the field, or provide aria-live/role semantics.
Name, birthday and email fields use relevant given-name, bday-* and email autocomplete tokens.
The existing-account path cannot reach a sign-in form and remains on Cloudflare verification, leaving no visible recovery or alternative beyond waiting.
The only img is an appropriately sized SVG with explicit dimensions; image audit finds no oversizing or legacy format.
A minimal static registration screen starts Google, DoubleClick and Yandex analytics, including six redirects and background collection calls.
Third parties transfer 314KB of 357KB total (88%), disproportionate to the sparse no-media entry page.
This public dating entry surface declares no agent-facing capability or agentic workflow, and none is necessary for the audited unauthenticated task.
checkOutcomes.reason: This public dating entry surface declares no agent-facing capability or agentic workflow, and none is necessary for the audited unauthenticated task.

checkOutcomes.evidence: The audited registration and directory tasks do not present a useful or necessary on-device inference use case.
checkOutcomes.reason: The audited registration and directory tasks do not present a useful or necessary on-device inference use case.

checkOutcomes.evidence: After 10 registration forward/back cycles, heap self size rose 3.2% and nodes 1.35%, a small first-use increase rather than evidence of unbounded growth.
Baseline heap is 7.52MB across 150,143 nodes, proportionate to this small page; post-cycle heap remains 7.76MB.
Aggregate nodes increased only 1.35% after repeated real step changes, with no compounding symptom in this bounded sample; constructor-level detached-node evidence was unavailable.

paths.description: Public entry and registration gate; primary acquisition surface and first registration state.
City directory/listing archetype representing public discovery and long-page navigation.
Existing-account login journey, a primary account flow.
Terms page representing long-form legal/content template.
Unknown route representing HTTP/navigation recovery state.

findings.evidence: The dark-condition screenshot is pixel-identical to light and computed color-scheme remains normal.
findings.suggestedFix: Declare color-scheme: light dark and provide preference-driven surface and text tokens.

findings.evidence: The registration DOM hides and shows step containers with no view-transition CSS.
findings.suggestedFix: Wrap step changes in document.startViewTransition with a no-motion fallback.

findings.summary: Long listings provide no scroll-position feedback
findings.evidence: The city directory extends well below the viewport while CSS has no scroll-state or progress affordance.
findings.suggestedFix: Keep active context visible and add a lightweight declarative scroll progress or scroll-state treatment.

findings.summary: Components do not respond to their containers
findings.evidence: CSS inspection found no @container rules and fixed-width component styles dominate.
findings.suggestedFix: Add container-type to reusable shells and adapt child layout with size container queries.

findings.summary: Keyboard focus is invisible and social targets are undersized
findings.evidence: Every tested focused control computed outline none; social links measure 32x32 CSS pixels.
findings.suggestedFix: Restore a high-contrast :focus-visible ring and enlarge compact social targets to at least 44x44 CSS pixels.

findings.summary: Existing-user login is blocked by verification
findings.evidence: The /auth journey stays on a Cloudflare “Verifying…” screen with no alternative or recovery.
findings.suggestedFix: Tune bot protection for the login route, bound verification time, and expose retry/support recovery.

findings.summary: Registration fields and errors are not accessibly associated
findings.evidence: The name input has no label and hidden .reg-error nodes have no role/aria-live; invalid submission leaves focus on body.
findings.suggestedFix: Use explicit labels, required semantics, aria-describedby, aria-invalid, and an aria-live error summary after interaction.

findings.summary: Analytics dominate delivery for a sparse page
findings.evidence: HAR: 314KB of 357KB is third-party; Google and Yandex scripts each take about 1.8s.
findings.suggestedFix: Load analytics after consent/idle, remove duplicate measurement, and defer non-critical first-party scripting.

findings.summary: Core text and actions fail WCAG AA contrast
findings.evidence: axe and Lighthouse report 8 failures at 3.5:1 for white text on #4d8ec5.
findings.suggestedFix: Darken the blue surface or change foreground colors to reach at least 4.5:1 for normal text.

findings.summary: Primary action links are JavaScript-only fragments
findings.evidence: The two registration choices use href="#" and onclick, so they have no crawlable destination or no-JS action.
findings.suggestedFix: Use buttons for state changes or real form submissions/URLs that work before JavaScript enhancement.

findings.summary: Public entity metadata lacks structured data
findings.evidence: Open Graph tags exist, but the structured-data probe found no JSON-LD.
findings.suggestedFix: Add accurate schema.org Organization/WebSite metadata matching visible content.

findings.summary: Session cookie and browser defenses are unsafe
findings.evidence: SESSIONID is not Secure or HttpOnly and uses SameSite=None; CSP, HSTS and nosniff are absent.
findings.suggestedFix: Set Secure, HttpOnly and appropriate SameSite on session cookies; deploy HSTS, CSP and nosniff plus explicit referrer/permissions policy.

findings.summary: Tracking starts before any visible choice
findings.evidence: Seven third-party origins load on entry, including Google/DoubleClick and Yandex; they transfer 314KB.
findings.suggestedFix: Minimise to one privacy-preserving measurement path, gate non-essential tracking on consent, and shorten retention.

findings.summary: No phishing-resistant sign-in option is exposed
findings.evidence: The inspected entry exposes five federated providers but no WebAuthn/passkey path; direct login is bot-gated.
findings.suggestedFix: Offer passkey registration/sign-in and retain accessible recovery alongside federated options.

findings.summary: The core entry experience is blank without JavaScript
findings.evidence: Rendered screenshot shows registration; crawler/no-JS screenshot is entirely blank.
findings.suggestedFix: Render the registration entry and meaningful links in server HTML, then enhance step behavior with JavaScript.

findings.summary: App-like site has no service worker fallback
findings.evidence: A manifest is linked, but no service-worker registration exists.
findings.suggestedFix: Add an installable manifest audit and a minimal service worker with offline shell/recovery for public routes.

findings.summary: Global location support is not translation-ready
findings.evidence: The country selector spans many locales, but the UI is fixed Russian and CSS contains physical left/right without logical-property support.
findings.suggestedFix: Externalise strings, use locale-aware formatting and CSS logical properties, and test RTL/long translations.

findings.summary: “Without registration” claim conflicts with the registration gate
findings.evidence: Title/meta promise use without registration while the first screen is headed Registration and begins account creation.
findings.suggestedFix: Make acquisition copy match the actual requirement, or provide the promised browse/use path without account creation.
